Hero.name: Xiaonan Dong
Hero.description: Frontend Developer focused on React and TypeScript, with hands-on experience in full-stack integration and backend architecture.

About.description: Frontend Developer with a passion for building interactive, pixel-perfect user interfaces. I have a strong foundation in React and TypeScript. Recently, I have been expanding my expertise into full-stack development, enabling me to handle end-to-end features—from designing database schemas with Prisma to managing secure user authentication—which gives me a broader perspective on how frontend and backend seamlessly integrate.

list.title: Music App

list.title: Movies App

list.title: Dashboard

list.title: E-commerce App

items.title: Junior Frontend Developer
items.description: This role involved standard web development and layout building within an agile team. Daily work focused on working together with backend engineers for API routing, syncing with UI/UX designers to implement designs, and communicating with the mobile app team for cross-platform pages.

items.title: Transition period
items.description: Career transition period working in music composition and English teaching, while gradually shifting focus toward frontend development through self-learning and personal projects.
